summary: RetireMentorship backend iteration-3 regression + new endpoint verification. All 22 pytest cases passed (22/22, 100%). New coverage: (1) GET /api/wp/latest-modified returns non-null ISO `modified` and int `id` (retry once with 3s pause per spec) — live response {modified: 2026-05-07T09:35:45, id: 15862}; (2) GET /api/admin/leads without X-Admin-Key → 401; (3) wrong X-Admin-Key → 401; (4) correct key rm_admin_ChangeMe_2026 → 200 with {total,count,leads} shape and count==len(leads); (5) /api/admin/leads.csv without key → 401; (6) with correct key → 200, Content-Type text/csv, exact header row 'email,name,retirement_stage,created_at,last_login,user_id,picture,source'. Regressions all green: /api/wp/categories non-empty, /api/wp/home-feed exposes hero/latest/videos/trending/tip, search=medicare returns >=1, single post has `modified`, auth 401 gates intact, in-process cache still fast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: LEADS_WEBHOOK_URL fires only for is_new_user. Consider validating it is a proper http(s) URL at startup and failing loudly if it looks malformed rather than silently swallowing httpx errors.

server.py admin_leads returns raw user docs including `picture` and `session`-adjacent fields; if in future more sensitive fields (tokens, hashes) are added to the users collection they will leak through this endpoint. Recommend explicit projection whitelist for /admin/leads.

server.py _check_admin: if ADMIN_API_KEY env is empty, all admin requests are rejected (good fail-closed). However there is no rate limit on admin endpoints — brute-force of the key is possible. Consider adding basic rate limiting.

server.py wp_get() line ~68 dict-vs-list default heuristic using `path.endswith(tuple(f'/{i}' for i in range(10)))` remains fragile (carried over from iter-2). Safer to accept an explicit `default` param.
server.py transform_post() still does not guard against WP error dicts (e.g., {'code':'rest_post_invalid_id',...}); an invalid post id would return a 200 with mostly-null fields instead of 404.
seed_data_creation: None — admin/leads tests validate shape only; endpoint tolerates empty users collection (count==0, leads==[]).
